column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: library.test.ts: the folder, the manifest, the package and the spec kit agree
package.test.ts: the entries a configuration imports are exported by name
package.test.ts: the launcher runs build and check on a fixture and finds the configuration upward
pack.test.ts: the package is packed with compiled modules, theme files, a launcher, a LICENSE and no link dependency
consumer.test.ts: the packed package installed into an empty project builds and checks a small repository
consumer.test.ts: a repository at another address has links to that address and names no other host

book.test.ts: the presentations are web, markdown, data and book, the site is what is written without a choice, and a book needs its volumes; the command line takes --presentation (one or several, by name) and --check for build, and refuses them for check; the files of a presentation are written, a book into a folder that holds other things leaves them, and a file that is not what a build writes is found; build --presentation book without a volume is refused, and the book is written and checked from the command line

book.test.ts: text that AsciiDoc would read as markup is passed through, a line that would be a list or a title begins safely, and a bracket is an attribute; every block is written: headings with anchors, lists, tables, code, callouts, entries, tabs, diagrams, cards and trees; a link to a page of the volume is a cross reference, to another is a link to the site where the book names one and its text where it does not; a volume is its parts' pages in the order of the navigation: a page is a chapter, a page under it a section, a page once, a part of each group, and a part that takes nothing is found; the files of a presentation are written, a book into a folder that holds other things leaves them, and a file that is not what a build writes is found
